stem: For XeF₂ , 2 bond pairs and 3 lone pairs exist. What is hybridisation and shape? (a) sp³d, linear (b) sp³d², octahedral (c) sp³, bent (d) sp², trigonal planar
Which of the following elements shows the capacity to form hybrid orbitals by using s, p and d atomic orbitals? (a) B (b) C (c) N (d) S
On hybridization of one s- and one p-orbital , we get: (a) two mutually perpendicular orbitals (b) two orbitals at 180° (c) four orbitals directed tetrahedrally (d) three orbitals in the plane
The molecule of CO₂ has angle 180°. It can be explained on the basis of: (a) sp³-hybridisation (b) sp-hybridisation (c) sp²-hybridisation (d) d²sp³-hybridisation

Which pair of species shows the same hybridisation of the central atom, despite having different shapes ? (i) XeF₄ and SF₆ (ii) PCl₅ and XeF₂ (iii) XeF₄ and [PF₆]⁻ (iv) CO₃²⁻ and BF₃ — (a) (i) only (b) (i) & (iii) (c) (i), (ii) & (iii) (d) All of these
